text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeeah!
Go, Smart Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I got... first place?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon! Center stage is yours!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It sure is! I'm taking center stage!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon!
Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So this is the Classics...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is what it feels like to be a top
Umadol!

Smart Falcon sings and dances from
center stage to the roaring delight of a
packed venue. She
shines even more
brilliantly than usual.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: D-did... did my song reach your heart?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was cheering so loud, I
couldn't hear
anything at all after a
while...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It did? It did?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then, that means... it must have reached

everyone...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That was sooo much fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! You know, the top stage is

something else!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All the lights in the crowd were way
brighter than
the spotlights! The whole
world in front of my
eyes was shining!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just felt so... connected to everyone!
Like we
were all feeling the same
emotions!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you get what I mean? Does that
make sense
to you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: I hear you loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I want to experience the same
thing in a
dirt race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to sing on the brightest, shiniest
stage in
the whole wide world!

Smart Falcon is dead serious all of a
sudden. Having gotten a taste of what
it's like at the top, she's more
determined than ever to make her dream
a reality.

Not only that, but I feel exactly the
same after
seeing her sing and dance on
the biggest stage
out there!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's make it happen!
choice_data_list: Next time, let's take in today's v...

text_block_list.text:
We go back to the waiting room and,
looking a little calmer than before,
Smart Falcon makes a
suggestion for her
next steps.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna run in a G1 dirt race next!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My rookie days are over. It's time to take
my next
step as an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And that step... is to get up on a stage
that'll
make me known all over the
country.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run more G1 races like the
Satsuki Sho!

It's clear that she now has what it takes
to
compete against the powerful runners
the G1
races attract. In which case...

It's a race reserved only for classic-year
racers,
just like the Satsuki Sho, and one
I'd love to see
her win.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good to me! Really, I'm good
with
anything as long as it's a G1!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's not a lot of G1 dirt races out
there... So
I've gotta get on every stage I
can!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next stop, the Japan Dirt Derby and the
top of
the dirt world! ☆

Our next goal is decided. Japan Dirt
Derby, here
we come!
